sync.webdavDescription: Send the backup to a WebDAV server, or restore from the file it holds.
sync.rememberPassword: Keep the password in the vault
sync.remotePathHint: Folders that are not there yet are created when a backup is uploaded.
sync.nothingOnServer: The server has no backup there yet.
sync.snippetDescription: Keep the same backup in a private gist or snippet. The first upload creates one, and its id is written down here so the next upload goes to the same place.
sync.snippetInstanceInsecure: An address starting with http:// sends the token in the clear. Use it only on a network you trust.
sync.snippetTokenKept: A token is kept for this account.
sync.snippetRememberToken: Keep the token in the vault
sync.snippetTokenHint: A GitHub token needs the gist scope, a GitLab one the api scope. A token is never part of the backup, and it is the one thing that is not in the settings file.
sync.snippetNoToken: Enter an access token first, or keep one.
sync.secretsToggle: Sync the stored passwords and keys
sync.secretsHint: They are sealed under the passphrase below before the file leaves this machine. Without a passphrase they are left out, and a snippet is refused rather than written without one.
sync.secretsPassphraseKept: A passphrase is kept, and a timed upload uses it.
sync.backupDescription: Write the sessions and their groups, the command library, the words and the chosen settings to a 7Shell backup file. A backup can be read back, with a look at what is inside it first.
sync.passphraseHint: The saved passwords and the imported keys are encrypted with it. Fill it in to take them with you, leave it empty and the backup carries neither. It is not saved.
sync.exportedPlain: Backed up {parts} to {file}, without any passwords.
sync.nothingToSay: The file held nothing this machine did not already have.
sync.replaced: {count} item was written over | {count} items were written over
sync.copied: {count} item arrived as a copy | {count} items arrived as copies
sync.missingKeys: {count} session names a key this device does not hold | {count} sessions name a key this device does not hold
sync.droppedHops: {count} session lost a jump host the file did not carry | {count} sessions lost a jump host the file did not carry
sync.includeSettings: Settings that travel — theme, colours, key bindings, layout
sync.includeHistoryHint: What was typed, host names and paths in it.
sync.includeHostsHint: Another machine would accept these hosts without asking.
sync.includeCredentialsHint: Needs the passphrase; without one they stay here.
sync.restoreMessage: {file} holds what is listed below. Nothing already here is replaced unless the box is ticked.
sync.sealed: This file is sealed, so it carries credentials. The passphrase on the panel is what opened it.
sync.replace: Replace items with the same id
sync.replaceHint: Off, an item whose id is already here arrives as a second copy. On, the file's version is written over it.
sync.autoUpload: Send a backup on a timer
sync.autoUploadHint: It runs only while this window is open, and it never downloads: a copy that overwrote this library without being asked to would be the worst surprise this feature could give.
